message:
feat!: refactor changelog generation to use freeform LLM categorization

WHY
Changelog generation was strictly tied to predefined project areas, preventing flexible, context-aware categorization when areas were not configured and causing unnecessary overhead during description retrieval and scope resolution.

WHAT
* Replaced area-based grouping and name mapping with a freeform LLM-driven approach using `generateFreeform`.
* Removed dependency on `projectCfg.Areas` for changelog generation and removed redundant map initialization in project config.
* Deleted redundant chunk scope resolution logic in `CommitService`.
* Simplified `OpenAIStandardAdapter` by removing project area retrieval during description construction.
* Updated `ReleaseService` to use freeform grouping as the default fallback.
* Updated documentation and changelog to reflect structural changes.
